claim: Original ink and mask do not reduce to simple transparency: some ink bits lie outside the mask, and colour masks are not binary, so keep the original mask-OR-ink support and the AND/OR per plane.

evidence.text: Opacity is mask OR ink, because original ink is not always a subset of mask.
